behavior: Keep final fitted compact-search page, restore larger source windows only through validated full-envelope probes preserving every delivered hit and current excerpt.

first_integration.cause: Four old no-crowding assertions compared identical snippet dictionaries and rejected strictly larger snippets that contained the full previous text.

causal_boundary: Four frozen Unicode/escaped-text short/long-workspace cases discard at least half the original window on baseline. Corrected delivery preserves more than three quarters at the same full serialized budget, retaining previous text and source coordinates.
assertion_update: All16 existing no-crowding variants remain. Their guard now requires same full non-preview identity, previous snippet containment and nonshrinking source lines instead of forbidding any excerpt extension.
controls: whole fitted hit prefix and continuation protected at four budgets
conservative nonmonotone counts never admit an overbudget page
upstream/unrelated omission flags preserved and own stale flags cleared
repeated source fragments retain corresponding rows/coordinates
actual gateway source-backed output within budget
fitting payload byte identity and caller nonmutation
limitations: No new corpus relevance queries, held-out labels, native cause attribution, optimality or speedup claim.
BPE counts and anchor windows can be nonmonotone; only the best observed protected actual fit is accepted.
Long workspace paths still consume the same response budget; path-independent output is not promised.
Only compact search rendering changes, using already rendered original windows; no extra retrieval or parsing.
All actual tests/runtime/fixtures/build/install/native execution was online GHA. Host work is static and private stdlib retained-data/Git/XML/tar analysis only.
